verdict.rationale: Poke is itself an AI assistant agent, so it occupies the MCP client role, and publishing an MCP server for other agents is a different product role. All MCP evidence describes Poke connecting to external MCP servers (`mcp add`, `tunnel`, recipes). The probe's 'official MCP server' label points to that same client-side page, and nothing shows Poke running as an MCP server itself.
